d:
So, here is the official song "O Womaniya" from the upcoming crime thriller Gangs of Wasseypur, directed by Anurag Kashyap. The star cast includes Manoj Bajpai, Nawazuddin Siddiqui, Huma Qureshi and others.
Song : O Womaniya
Singer: Khushboo Raaj (Varanasi), Rekha Jha (Patna)
Movie: Gangs Of Wasseypur
Music Director: Sneha Khanwalkar
Lyricist: Varun Grover
Music Label: T-Series
Enjoy and stay connected with us!!
